problem: Production pricing browser proof reached the exact deploy and pricing interactions, but NL→EN navigation timed out because the injected mobile English link on /prijzen still pointed to /en/ instead of /en/prijzen.
root_cause: tools/site-shell/apply-i18n.mjs injected one hard-coded mobile language block with href=/ and href=/en/ into all source pages. build-localized-routes rewrote language switchers only inside generated locale directories, while the canonical Dutch unprefixed route continued to serve the root source file. Therefore Dutch non-home routes kept homepage-only language links.

evidence.production_failure: page.waitForURL timeout during first NL→EN pricing switch
evidence.public_readback: /prijzen mobile English link resolved to /en/ instead of /en/prijzen
evidence.exact_deploy_precondition: pricing runtime/content proof had already passed before locale navigation failed

prevention: The source-level i18n injector must derive the current canonical route from the file path.
Dutch and English mobile links must target the same logical page: /route ↔ /en/route.
Existing injected switchers must be rewritten, not merely skipped, so stale homepage-only links cannot survive.
Generated /en/* inputs must strip the locale prefix before computing targets to prevent /en/en/*.
Production closure still requires NL→EN→NL browser navigation on pricing plus mandatory public routes.
truth_boundary: A route-aware build contract is not production proof until the exact production browser readback passes.
